description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sandagiripura, Tissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land classification details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
